backlog: `Core\Topic`'s three members (`subscribe`, `publish`, `unsubscribe`) owe every proof and the class card: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs:209`, card line at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5348` — the group after `Core\Totp`.

`Zone::of` accepts a name in any letter case (`EUROPE/BERLIN`) and stores it as written; the zone database lookup ignores case. Not a bug, and not pinned by a `.nvst` case yet — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` module doc owns `Zone`.
